destructiveChanges: Removed 50 historical worktrees from the SHA-256-bound precleanup inventory; the main worktree was preserved because Git forbids removing it.
Removed seven exact historical origin/codex branches; final fetch proves only origin/main remains.
Removed stale local branches/worktrees, then moved the unique main checkout to the repository root.
observedIssues: Git correctly refused removal of the repository root because it is the main working tree; the procedure adapted by removing the duplicate main worktree and checking out synchronized main at the root.
Five historical commits became unreachable after detached worktree removal; their SHAs were reported by Git and no replacement branch was created to preserve the user-required single-main state.
